description: Semantic paraphrase search inside one saved source using an explicitly prepared offline multilingual model. Returns exact excerpts/offsets, source hash, PDF page numbers and model/chunk identity after considering the complete bounded source. Scores are cosine similarity, not evidence quality or confidence. Follow next_rank using after_rank; no result proves scientific validity. Missing assets/busy/over-limit work fail explicitly; no remote embedding or lexical fallback is used. Literal researcher_source_search remains available separately.
